notes: Sessions May/Nov; TZ1/TZ2 can be attached locally later.

Local PDF attach stores file name and size in localStorage; binaries never commit.
The mcq-demo paper is original isomorphic practice data, separate from placeholder past-paper cards.

mcqDemoPapers.title: AA-style MCQ practice paper · original demo
mcqDemoPapers.description: Original isomorphic practice items for testing the sit UI; not an IB past paper.

items.prompt: If 3x + 4 = 19, what is x?
What is the gradient of y = 2x − 7?
items.solution: The coefficient of x is the gradient, so it is 2.

items.prompt: Which value equals 2³ × 2²?
For f(x) = x² + 1, what is f(3)?
What is the derivative of x³?
What is ∫ 4x dx?
What is the exact value of sin(π/6)?
The roots of x² − 5x + 6 = 0 are:
A fair six-sided die is rolled once. What is P(even)?
items.solution: There are three even outcomes out of six, giving 1/2.

items.prompt: What is the mean of 2, 4, 7 and 11?
The vector (3, 4) has magnitude:
If z = 1 + i, what is |z|?
What is the coefficient of x² in (x + 2)³?
A sequence has first term 5 and common difference 3. What is its fifth term?
What is the sum of the first four terms of 2, 6, 18, …?
The line y = 3x + 1 crosses the y-axis at:
What is the determinant of [[2, 1], [3, 4]]?
If X ~ Bin(4, 0.5), what is P(X = 2)?
What is the range of y = √(x − 1)?
items.solution: A square root is non-negative, so y ≥ 0.

items.prompt: For 0 < θ < π/2, tan θ = 1 implies θ =:
items.solution: The acute angle with tangent 1 is π/4.

items.prompt: What is the second derivative of eˣ?
A normal distribution is centered at its:
items.solution: The mean is the center of a normal distribution.

items.prompt: If vectors u and v are perpendicular, their dot product is:
What is the limit of (x² − 1)/(x − 1) as x approaches 1?
items.solution: Factor to x + 1, then substitute x = 1 to get 2.
